title: SQL Injection
description: User-controlled input reaches a SQL query.
evidence: Input influences a backend SQL query.
recommendation: Use parameterized queries or prepared statements.

title: Broken Access Control
description: A user can access another user's resource by modifying an object identifier.
evidence: Changing the user_id allows access to another user's data.
recommendation: Enforce server-side authorization checks for every protected resource.

title: Security Misconfiguration
description: The application exposes unnecessary debugging information.
evidence: Debug information is accessible without authentication.

title: Cryptographic Failure
description: Sensitive information is transmitted without adequate encryption.
evidence: Sensitive data is transmitted over an unencrypted connection.
recommendation: Use HTTPS and strong modern cryptographic protocols.

title: Authentication Failure
description: The application does not adequately protect authentication attempts.
evidence: Repeated authentication attempts are accepted without effective rate limiting.
recommendation: Implement rate limiting and strong authentication protections.
